# The files over 1,000 lines that stay whole, and why.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#
# tools/check_sizes.py --check holds the tree to this list: a file over
# 1,000 lines that is not here fails, and so does a listed file at or under
# 1,000.  "figure +-tolerance" records a line count that is held; "none"
# records none.  F<n> is a fork, "row <n>" a row, of the code size plan
# (rework/codesize-plan.md on branch rework/codesize).  Files generated by
# a tools/gen_*.py that CI runs with --check are the generator's to hold
# and are not listed.
#
# path | lines | reason

# Data, not code: no file covered here is split for its size.
exclude hardware/research/* | the component research's run records, written by the research tool
exclude *.json | data: drawings, anchors, profiles and the configurator's package lock
exclude test/host/fixtures/* | recorded bench captures the host suite replays as they were taken

# What stays over 1,000 lines after the plan.
firmware/panel/main/main.c | 2422 +-100 | the panel's start, its main loop and the console report; rows 24 to 27 moved the rest out (plan about 2,214)
shared/ui/servo_screen.c | 3564 +-100 | the sweep core reads 98 fields of the screen's state; rows 20, 21, 31 and 22 moved the overlays and the link client out
shared/ui/esc_stick_panel.c | 3451 +-100 | row 19 created it; its 16 drawers, about 1,470 lines, can go to esc_stick_draw.c later
shared/bench/kst_prog.c | 2407 +-100 | row 7 moved the card and file parts out; the session engine stays one file
shared/servo/servo_limrun.c | 1044 +-100 | row 29 moved the report out (F18); the search stays one file
shared/outputs/servo_link.c | 1393 +-100 | row 22 created it behind link_port_t; no second cut (owner decision)
shared/ui/servo_settings_panel.c | none | row 20 created it; the drawers moved with the overlay
